body: Ye packed Night Two of his sold-out Chicago homecoming at Soldier Field with 70,000 fans and a stacked lineup of special guests. Chief Keef, Big Sean, 2 Chainz, Rick Ross, Don Toliver @dontoliver, Travis Scott @travisscott, Young Thug @thuggerthugger1, CyHi, Really Doe, GLC, Consequence, Twista, Common, Lupe Fiasco and Kid Cudi all joined Ye throughout the night for performances across different eras of his catalog.

source_caption_text:
Ye packed Night Two of his sold-out Chicago homecoming at Soldier Field with 70,000 fans and a stacked lineup of special guests. 🔥

Chief Keef, Big Sean, 2 Chainz, Rick Ross, Don Toliver, Travis Scott, Young Thug, CyHi, Really Doe, GLC, Consequence, Twista, Common, Lupe Fiasco and Kid Cudi all joined Ye throughout the night for performances across different eras of his catalog.
